[Fix] The blood residue of monster's death is not shown.

notes.title: Update v1.5.0

Change log:

Change log:
[Change] Change the developer information.

notes.title: Update v1.4.0
notes.notes:
Change log:
[New] The footsteps replaying can be interrupted now.
[Improve] Adjusted the center position of some levels.

notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.notes:
Change log:
[Improve] Improve the guided process of the first glove level (level 41).
[Modify] When you equip the gloves and some operations do not meet the conditions of pulling, the system will automatically switch to move mode.

notes.title: Update v1.2.12
notes.notes: [Fix] When picking up the equipment and switching to it at the same time, causing the equipment icon animation errors.

notes.title: Update v1.2.11
notes.notes:
change log:
[Fix] In some cases, S14 and S15 are not unlocked correctly.
[Fix] Quickly changing equipment will cause the equipment icon become bigger and bigger.

notes.title: Update v1.2.10
notes.notes:
change log:
[Fix] In some cases, Steam achievements cannot be unlocked correctly.
[Fix] When enter the last level, and then exit the level without clearing it. The ending dialogue still shows up.
[Fix] Switching equipment with the numeric keyboard, an error occurs in some cases.
